name: ACS Spring Picnic
description: Come out for food and fun at the ACS Spring Picnic! We will have hamburgers (veggie burgers for vegetarians) and hot dogs and lots of delicious treats. Activities include volleyball, basketball, frisbee, and a variety of board games. You will also have a chance to win a periodic table blanket! The cost is $2 for non-members and FREE for everyone else. Sign-ups are posted on the board outside the chemistry suite. Hope to see you there!
